hanx_modern.label: HanX modern district
hanx_modern.note: Native HanX homes, shops and schools with matching park furnishings. Models keep their supplied scale in either world.

historical.label: Historical village district
historical.note: Reviewed historical village families, brick lanes, courtyard wells and occasional wayside shrines. Flat sprite artwork in 3D; no modern fillers. The seed chooses one shared palette and lighting appearance for the whole district.

industrial.label: Industrial services district
industrial.note: Three supplied vehicle-service building designs and matching yard props. No housing, schools or green parks are invented to fill this limited theme.

korean_street.label: Korean street · limited local use
korean_street.note: One home and three commercial subjects in 2D. No matching park or street props are supplied; none are substituted. Existing flat 3D cards obscure ground-floor art. Source-project ZIP redistribution is restricted.

village.label: Village district
village.note: Supplied village building families and palette appearances. Wells form small shared courtyards; wayside shrines are optional scenery. These are flat sprite cards in 3D. The seed chooses one shared palette and lighting appearance for the whole district.
